sentences.text: Douglas Anthony Ducey -LSB- ˈduːsi -RSB- -LRB- born April 9 , 1964 -RRB- is an American businessman and politician who is the 23rd and current governor of the U.S. State of Arizona .	23rd	List of Governors of Arizona	23rd and current governor	List of Governors of Arizona	Arizona	Arizona
He is a member of the Republican Party , and was sworn in as governor on January 5 , 2015 .	Republican	Republican Party (United States)	Republican Party	Republican Party (United States)
Prior to his governorship , he served as the state 's 42nd treasurer .	treasurer	State Treasurer of Arizona
He is also the first man to serve as Arizona Governor in over 17 years .	Arizona	Arizona
Prior to serving in elected office , Ducey served as the CEO of Cold Stone Creamery before he and his business partner sold the company in 2007 .	Cold Stone Creamery	Cold Stone Creamery

On November 4 , 2014 , Ducey won the election to become governor of the State of Arizona , the first open seat for governor in 12 years , succeeding Jan Brewer .	Jan Brewer	Jan Brewer	Arizona	Arizona	election	Arizona gubernatorial election, 2014
Born in Toledo , Ohio , Ducey moved to Tempe , Arizona in 1982 where he attended Arizona State University .	Arizona	Arizona	Tempe	Tempe, Arizona	Arizona State University	Arizona State University

In addition to his involvement with Cold Stone Creamery , he also worked at a local Anheuser-Busch distributor during his time in college , and Procter & Gamble following his graduation with a degree in finance .	Cold Stone Creamery	Cold Stone Creamery	Procter & Gamble	Procter & Gamble
